name: Csaroda (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of red over white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Csaroda (a green, white and blue shield with a lion, a flower and a lizard) above the name CSARODA in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
